messages:
Elaine: hi team — customer (Sophie) reports the embeddings endpoint intermittently returning vectors with the wrong dimension when using our TS SDK batcher. Happens after retries/timeouts kick in :thinking:
Sophie: yup, we've had production failures since yesterday. only during traffic spikes + 5xxs, client retries, then some vectors are 1024 instead of expected 512 and our DB schema errors out.
Elaine: repro steps I used (staging):
1) ts sdk v1.4.2 batcher config: batch_size=32, timeout_ms=200
2) concurrent clients ~100 qps with jitter
3) inject intermittent 502 from backend to trigger retries
4) observe some responses with length 512 and some 1024 in same time window
Mike: @Raj can you check whether this looks like a model routing fallback (different model dims) or an SDK batching bug?
Raj: quick thoughts — different model variants have different dims. If routing/fallback occurs after a timeout the client could be talking to embed-1024-v2 instead of embed-512-v1. Need request_id, x-model header, and batch_id to correlate. Also check SDK's batch key (should include model+version).
Li: infra note: cluster rolling update + autoscale events at ~15:01 UTC yesterday. some backends were on v1 (512) and others on v2 (1024) during overlap. possible routing during failover.
Elaine: attaching minimal TS snippet we used:
```ts
// client init
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, timeout: 200 });
await client.embeddings.create({
  model: 'embed-512-v1',
  input: batchOfTexts
});
```
Elaine: sample response headers from a good request:
```
x-request-id: req_abc123
x-model: embed-512-v1
x-backend: rw-eu-2
```
Elaine: and when we got bad vectors the headers were:
```
x-request-id: req_def456
x-model: embed-1024-v2
x-backend: rw-us-4
```
Raj: that confirms routing to the wrong model. Why did the retry hit a different model though? SDK retry logic can resend to any healthy endpoint. If model pinning isn't enforced during retry it can land on a different variant. Also batcher correctness: ensure it doesn't combine items for different models into one batch when model changes mid-flight.
Mike: another angle — if the batcher uses a pool keyed only by model name (not version/checksum/region) and we rolled a model upgrade with a new dimension and same name, race could mix dims. the batch key must be strict.
Elaine: I reproduced locally by toggling routing in staging: spawned 50 parallel requests with jitter, killed half of backends to force retries. repro logs show mixed x-model headers under same batch id.
Raj: paste sample logs?
Elaine:
``
[15:02:13] batch_id=batch_987 model=embed-512-v1 backend=rw-eu-2 req=req_01 len=512
[15:02:13] batch_id=batch_987 model=embed-1024-v2 backend=rw-us-4 req=req_02 len=1024
``
Li: deploy-bot: service rw-serving group embeders rolled new version across clusters at 15:01 UTC.
Mike: immediate mitigation ideas: add a client-side guard in SDK that checks returned vector length against model profile and on mismatch either drop+retry (same model) or fail fast with a clear error so client don't insert bad vectors. Also increase timeout/backoff to reduce cross-region retry.
Raj: infra/backend fixes: pin routing during retries to the original model/version and region; treat retries as sticky to the original backend for ephemeral windows. also make batch key include model checksum + region. add telemetry/alert when a single batch_id reports heterogeneous dims.
Elaine: customer impact: DB insert failures leading to application crash. Sophie, can you ship a hotfix to client that rejects wrong-dim vectors and retries with jitter/backoff?
Sophie: yes, we can ship a patch today to validate length and backoff. will report back after deploy.
Mike: I'll open a PR to add the SDK guard + tighten batch key. Raj, can you add a backend change ticket to pin retries? Li, can you pin this customer's traffic to eu + embed-512-v1 until we fully roll?
Li: will pin via routing rules for the customer id.
Elaine: assigning next steps: Mike PR (SDK guard), Raj backend pin+batch-key change, Li routing pin, Sophie client patch. I'll update customer after routing pin is live and we validate.
Sophie: thanks team :heart:
Mike: I'll also add a small telemetry dashboard to surface mixed-dimension incidents and a short runbook on how to mitigate.
Raj: long-term we should fail batch composition if any item in the batch has a different model checksum; this will prevent silent mixing.
Elaine: thanks all — will follow up in this thread with validation results.
